table_description: Fact table for sales through physical retail stores. This is the LARGEST table (~300 billion rows in SF100TCL). Contains one row per line item sold in a store transaction.
use_cases: Customer purchase behavior in physical stores
data_quality_notes: SS_SOLD_DATE_SK can be NULL — indicates date is unknown
SS_CUSTOMER_SK can be NULL — anonymous/cash transactions
Monetary columns (SS_SALES_PRICE, SS_NET_PROFIT etc.) are DECIMAL — use SUM not COUNT for revenue
SS_QUANTITY can be 0 or negative for returns processed in-store
This table has ~300B rows in SF100TCL — ALWAYS use date filters and LIMIT
Join to DATE_DIM on SS_SOLD_DATE_SK = D_DATE_SK for date attributes
SS_NET_PROFIT = SS_NET_PAID - SS_NET_PAID_INC_TAX costs — can be negative

key_columns.name: SS_SOLD_DATE_SK
key_columns.description: FK to DATE_DIM — date the sale occurred

key_columns.name: SS_SOLD_TIME_SK
key_columns.description: FK to TIME_DIM — time the sale occurred

key_columns.name: SS_CUSTOMER_SK
key_columns.description: FK to CUSTOMER — who bought it (nullable for anonymous)
